why: Result: Failed.
In Tech View, each technician's group heading shows a round picture (their initials) and their name.
Pointing at the name shows the technician's name, as it should.
Pointing at the round picture shows nothing.
The requirement says pointing at the heading or the picture shows the technician's name.
Already reported by Ahtasham Amjad (SV-11075), so no second ticket was raised.
Test again once SV-11075 is fixed.
Result: Failed — marked by Ahtasham Amjad on 12 Oct 2026.
Our own run on 8 Oct passed for a work order with no shift on the Schedule: the lines that followed the old lead moved to the new lead.
Ahtasham found the case where it breaks: the work order is already on the Schedule as a whole-work-order shift for today that hasn't finished.
In that case, after the lead is changed in Board View, the line still shows the old technician instead of following the new lead.
The requirement says lines that follow the lead move to the new lead.
Test again once SV-11128 is fixed.
Result: Failed — marked by Ahtasham Amjad on 12 Oct 2026.
When a move cannot be saved, the card should go back to where it was and the alert "Failed to update lead technician, please try again." should show.
Our own run on 8 Oct passed when the save was refused by the server.
Ahtasham found the case where it breaks: with the computer offline, a card dragged from Unassigned to a technician stays there and no alert shows.
When the connection comes back, the move is saved anyway.
Test again once SV-11074 is fixed.
Result: Failed — marked by Ahtasham Amjad on 12 Oct 2026.
When the old lead has a whole-work-order shift, changing the lead in Board View or Tech View should first ask "Clear <name>'s scheduled shifts?".
Our own run on 8 Oct passed with a shift booked for the next day.
Ahtasham found the case where it breaks: when the shift is today and hasn't finished, changing the lead in Board View shows no question at all.
Test again once SV-11126 is fixed.
Result: Failed.
Board View > Fields to display offers 13 optional fields for the cards.
With all 13 turned on, 12 show the right value on the card.
Estimated hours never shows on any card, even when the work order's lines have estimated time (for example 0.3 + 1.5 + 0.4 hours).
On production, a work order's estimated hours is the total of its lines' estimates, so there is a value to show.
The requirement says the optional fields use their existing production meaning.
Reported as SV-11106; the QA lead decided on 12 Oct 2026 to keep it.
Test again once SV-11106 is fixed.
Result: Failed.
If your saved Work Orders choices fail to load, Board View and Tech View correctly fall back to their default fields — that part works.
But the next field you turn on is not saved: after a reload it is gone again.
The requirement says: "Save the user's next field selection after a preference-load failure."
A normal field change a moment earlier did save, so the saving itself works.
To repeat it, a developer has to make the saved choices fail to load.
Reported as SV-11117; the QA lead decided on 12 Oct 2026 to keep it.
Test again once SV-11117 is fixed.
